title: Manifest the top card of another player's library
clause: "you manifest the top card of that player's library" (Thieving Amalgam); "manifest the top card of that player's library" (Orochi Soul-Reaver)
why: game/battlefield_put.go ManifestForEffect(playerID) takes one player who is both the library's owner and the controller. Cloak already has the split door (game/cloak.go CloakTopOfLibraryForEffect(controller, libraryOwner)); manifest needs the same, with owner != controller for the face-down permanent and its CR 708 look permission.
checked: grep 'func .*Manifest[A-Za-z]*(' in game/: ManifestForEffect(playerID), ManifestFromHandsKeyedForEffect, ManifestDread* only; grep "manifest the top card of (that player|target opponent|their)" in effects: 0; every effects caller passes the controller.

cards.name: Thieving Amalgam
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, you manifest the top card of that player's library. (Put it onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Whenever a creature you control but don't own dies, its owner loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
